tools.name: aeh_check_curriculum
tools.description: Fail-closed curriculum gate for one host-catalog item id, authorised student reference, and mode (preview/learn/review). Returns allowed plus machine-readable refusal reasons. It never delivers the item; missing annotations, low confidence, untaught KCs, future methods, an unknown mode, or an exhausted load budget reject the candidate. The model cannot override the gate.

itemId.description: Host-catalog item id; annotations resolve from the host, not the model.

studentRef.description: Opaque authorised student reference for this session.

tools.name: aeh_generate_report
tools.description: Aggregate already-authorised aggregate events into a minimised teacher/guardian report. The input is fixed to aggregate counters (attempts, correct counts, hint/review counts, minutes) plus an opaque consent scope; there is no field for a question, answer, image, step trace, arbitrary payload, or raw learning-event id. Events for another student, outside the window, unauthorised for the audience, or duplicated are excluded and only counted. The output contains aggregate totals and topic ids, never source references. This is a reporting boundary, not an identity/consent service.

audience.description: Report audience whose scope set applies.

studentRef.description: Opaque pseudonymous student reference in the report.

windowStart.description: Inclusive ISO start of the reporting window.

windowEnd.description: Exclusive ISO end of the reporting window.

events.description: Authorised aggregate events; each carries its own consent scope.

authorizedScopes.description: Optional caller scope list; it can only narrow the audience defaults.

tools.name: aeh_prepare_intervention
tools.description: Validate and prepare an intervention package: training items, hint ladder, feedback templates, explanation resources, independent unseen transfer items, completion criteria, and required KCs. Resolves every training/transfer id from the host catalog, then checks structure, training/transfer isolation, gate admission for every item, and seen-before transfer leakage. Returns deliveryEligible but never delivers; a host must obtain approval and re-check consent before delivery.

studentRef.description: Opaque authorised student reference for this session.

tools.name: aeh_schedule_review
tools.description: Apply FSRS-style observations to a supplied memory state and return the updated stability/difficulty, next review interval for the target retention, and counts. Reading an explanation has zero retrieval weight; hint-assisted success is weaker than an independent unhinted first attempt. Pure computation: no database or twin write.

state.description: Current memory state for one learner x memory unit.

targetRetention.description: Target retention in (0, 1); defaults to plugin config.

tools.name: aeh_select_probe
tools.description: Choose the best diagnostic probe for a session. Every candidate carries only a host-catalog item id; the tool resolves trusted annotations and re-runs the fail-closed gate, so a model-supplied item annotation or "allowed" flag is not accepted. Score = information gain + teaching value - time/risk/cognitive-load penalties. Returns null when the student skips or no candidate is allowed. Nothing is asked or persisted.

candidates.description: Candidate host item ids with predicted correctness per hypothesis.

itemId.description: Host-catalog item id, not an inline curriculum object.

studentRef.description: Opaque authorised student reference for this session.

mode.description: Curriculum mode used to re-check every candidate.

skipped.description: True when the student explicitly declines diagnosis.

tools.name: aeh_update_hypotheses
tools.description: Apply one session-scoped virtual-student hypothesis operation (snapshot, spawn, split, merge, prune, or Bayesian reweight with noise) to a supplied snapshot and return the normalised next snapshot plus weights. Pure state: it writes no long-term evidence, no database, and no observed twin state. The unknown bucket is always represented.

state.description: Current session hypothesis snapshot; omit when snapshotRef is supplied.

snapshotRef.description: Session/agent-scoped snapshot reference from a previous call. Loaded only for the same dsh session; an unknown, foreign, or expired reference fails closed.

hypothesisId.description: For split/prune: the target hypothesis id.

children.description: For split: at least two distinguishable children.

hypothesisIds.description: For merge: at least two source hypothesis ids.

likelihoods.description: For reweight: P(E | H_i) for active hypotheses.

evidenceRef.description: For reweight: opaque session evidence reference.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

data.system:
Create a concise title for an AI coding-assistant session from the supplied human messages.
Return only the title on one line, **in plain text of natural language**, with no quotes, prefix, explanation, Markdown, XML, or terminal control codes. No code is allowed.
Use the language of the messages.
Aim for about 5 words in non-CJK languages or 10 CJK characters.
If the messages give little to name, still return a short best-effort title, such as Greeting, instead of explaining.
